name: Morning research brief
tagline: Wake up to a one-page summary of the topics you care about
description: Pick a handful of topics. Every morning your team researches each one, writes a short summary, and emails (or saves) a single combined briefing — so you start the day informed without scrolling.
starterPrompt: Research these topics and write a short, plain-English summary of each, then combine them into a single one-page brief and save it to my Desktop: WebAssembly, Bun, Rust async runtimes.
defaultGoal: Stay current on the topics that matter, without losing an hour to feeds.
